name: AI Support Triage
author: Knotarium
description: Turns a raw customer email into structured data, a routed decision, and a ready-to-send reply — three AI skills in one run. AI Prompt extracts JSON facts (name, order number, sentiment, urgency), AI Router routes the message down a Complaint / Question / Praise branch, and a second AI Prompt drafts an empathetic reply that chains the extracted facts into its prompt. Self-contained sample message included — just press Run. Requires an AI provider under Settings → AI Provider (local OpenAI-compatible endpoints work too).
